answer: Attesting is a wager: a peer escrows 275,000 POA, one epoch payout, on whether this answer clears the five-lane median. Wrong calls fund right ones, so signing unread is a donation. The stake is the pigment the ledger reads for three epochs; repeat misses cut slots to zero. Farm math sours: puppet answers read like velvet, smooth and interchangeable, and template reuse drags pass rates to one in three, so a thousand keys earn 90 million POA and forfeit 183 million while 275 million stays locked. Honest miners keep a small ember of profit from the fee split, enough to pay for reading.
